versions.name: Scouting Heritage
versions.description: Trace Scouting from Baden-Powell and Brownsea Island to the people who grew the movement in this country, gather patches and memorabilia, revive an old-time Scout game, and interview Scouts from earlier generations.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
